NP Presspad 1.2.6 — Featured images, and knowing when something failed

Fixes for the featured image picker, clearer errors throughout, and a What's New note after each update. **No companion plugin update needed.**

## Featured images

- Choosing a featured image from the site's media library now shows it straight away. It previously looked as though the click had done nothing: the image was set correctly behind the scenes, but the preview couldn't display it until the post's image list happened to reload — up to 30 seconds later, and longer if you kept typing.
- Uploading a new featured image had the same delay, and is fixed too.
- Choosing from images already in the post was never affected.

## When something goes wrong, the app says so

Several actions failed silently, which made a genuine error look identical to a button that simply didn't work. Each of these now explains itself:

- Choosing or uploading a featured image.
- Inserting images into a post from the media library.
- Creating a category or a tag. These were worse than silent — the name you typed was cleared even when the term wasn't created, so a failure looked like a success. The name is now kept so you can try again.

## What's new

- After updating, the app shows a summary of what changed. It appears once per update, and never on a first install.
- You can read it again at any time from Settings, next to the update controls.
